overview_description.description: Jupiter is Shopify for the 30k+ food creators on TikTok & Instagram. Jupiter is a YC company founded out of Stanford. Jupiter helps food creators launch their own grocery powered recipe stores. These stores are integrated with the social shopping tools so followers can shop directly from their social feeds. Orders are processed through delivery APIs. Jupiter has acquired some of the largest food creators in the world including Half Baked Harvest, Carolina Gelen and Molly Baz. Creators monetize by running brand sponsorships on their store.

product.name: Jupiter Influencer Marketing Platform
product.description: A platform connecting food brands with social media food creators to produce and amplify branded recipe content for consumer engagement and commerce.

product.name: Jupiter Shoppable Recipe Storefronts
product.description: Digital storefronts where branded products are featured in shoppable recipes, allowing consumers to purchase all ingredients with a single tap.

product.name: Jupiter + Instagram Shopping Integration
product.description: An integration that places branded products on Instagram Shopping, providing prime digital shelf space for food brands within influencer content.

product.name: Jupiter Marketing Analytics Dashboard
product.description: An executive dashboard providing detailed marketing insights and performance metrics for influencer campaigns.

product.name: Jupiter Lite Meal Planning App
product.description: A free meal planning app that recommends recipes and generates smart shopping lists to help consumers reduce food waste and plan meals.
